item.title: Vibe Coding a Morse Code News Practice Page
item.description: I vibe coded a small Morse code practice page that turns current news headlines into CW audio, then linked it up with a couple of older Morse code reference tools: a cheat sheet and a decoder tree.

item.title: Whidbey Island Dashboard
item.description:
We recently bought a vacation home on Whidbey Island — and I turned a
spare TV into an ambient dashboard showing tides, weather, and ferry
schedules. It's free to use at whidbey-dashboard.mckoss.com.

item.title: The Paper Enigma
item.description: This paper simulator of a German Enigma machine is 100% compatible with the real thing; you can send and receive messages between the Paper Enigma and the WWII-era cryptography machine.
